Rhea: Quick heads-up  30m bench & battle sprint tomorrow 10:00 PT. Goal: agree 2 defensible bench callouts, 3 SDR hooks (short), and a one-sheet rebut map vs cloud/managed/infra. Who's in? :crossed_swords:
Ben: I'll join. I'll pull median+tail numbers for 128/512 token runs and a short note on quant configs.
Carmen: In. I'll draft 3 SDR hooks (PLG / AE / Tech) and a demo slide showing routing fallbacks.
Zack: I'll sketch the rebut sheet: objection -> quick rebut -> supporting datapoint. Also propose inbound routing rule for demo requests.
Rhea: Sample SDR hooks for iteration:
  PLG: "Ship chat that stays fast and costs less per interaction."
  AE: "SLA-backed inference with private deployments and predictable tails."
  Tech: "Efficient batching + KV cache + quant kernels = lower unit cost, same latency."
Ben: Bench phrasing: use qualifiers. e.g., "In our benchmark, up to 3-4x lower unit cost under typical chat loads; see appendix." Don't say "always".
Carmen: For inbound routing: if form contains latency|SLA|private|dedicated|throughput|predictable -> tag enterprise-team, else growth-queue. Regex: /(latency|SLA|private|dedicated|throughput|predictable)/i
Zack: Rebut snippets to include: "We already use CloudX" -> "They scale; we give predictable latency and lower unit spend via runtime batching and prefix caching."
Rhea: Action items: Ben -> upload bench CSVs + appendix link; Carmen -> SDR hooks + demo slide; Zack -> 1-sheet rebut map and routing rule to ops. I'll run the sprint and collate outputs.
route-bot: Calendar invite created for 10:00-10:30 PT. Pre-read link: https://notion.company/redwood/bench-battle-3098765432
Rhea: Keep public-facing claims conservative and always link to appendix. We'll finalize and hand off a one-pager to SDRs by Friday. :thumbsup:
_meta: bench & battle sprint: messaging iteration vs cloud AI platforms, managed LLM APIs, infra vendors
